connect_share.setup.title: Share this world
connect_share.setup.description: Linked friends can join this and future worlds without another link.
connect_share.setup.internet.tooltip: Optional. Reveals your public IP address to invited modded guests. Connect remains the relay fallback.
connect_share.setup.persistence: Sharing resumes automatically when you switch or reopen a world.
connect_share.status.title: World ready for friends
connect_share.status.link_help: Send the friend link once. After saving it, future worlds appear automatically.
connect_share.status.connection_help: The best connection is chosen automatically: direct when possible, Connect otherwise.
connect_share.status.waiting: No one is waiting for a response.
connect_share.join.title: Join Connect Share
connect_share.join.description: Choose a nearby world or paste its signed invitation.
connect_share.join.scanning: Scanning for nearby Connect Share worlds…
connect_share.join.offline.tooltip: The host will see this identity as unverified and must approve it.
connect_share.join.internet.tooltip: Optional. Reveals your public IP address to the host. Connect remains the relay fallback.
connect_share.friends.title: Friends
connect_share.friends.description: Friends appear here when they're ready to play.
connect_share.friends.copy_my_link.toolt: Share your stable friend link from any menu. No world needs to be open.
connect_share.friends.empty: No friends or sent requests yet. Paste a friend's link to send one.
connect_share.friends.request_failed: Request could not be delivered. Your friend may be offline or not reachable directly yet.
connect_share.notification.follow_waitin: A join request will be sent when their next world is ready. Cancel from Friends.
connect_share.notification.follow_ready_: Open Friends to join now; active gameplay was not interrupted.
connect_share.notification.follow_expire: %s did not become joinable in time.
connect_share.friends.friend_unreachable: Your friend is not reachable over libp2p right now.
connect_share.friends.add_description: Paste your friend's link and send a request. They can accept while their game is open.
connect_share.friends.name: Friend's name
connect_share.friends.name_hint: Name of the person who sent the link
connect_share.friends.notify: Notify me when their world is ready
connect_share.friends.share_worlds: Share my worlds with this friend
connect_share.friends.auto_join.tooltip: Skips the approval prompt only when their mod proves the saved libp2p identity.
connect_share.privacy.title: Privacy
connect_share.privacy.description: Choose what confirmed friends can see. People who are not your friends receive nothing.
connect_share.privacy.current_server: Show the server or world name
connect_share.privacy.confirmed_only: Friend requests, removals, and blocks take effect before presence or joining.
connect_share.friends.remove_confirm.mes: They will no longer be trusted automatically. You can add their friend link again later.
connect_share.notification.join_request_: %s wants to join. Open Connect Share to accept or decline.
connect_share.notification.friend_reques: %s sent a friend request. Open Connect Share to accept or decline.
connect_share.notification.friend_online: %s is playing %s. Open Friends to request to join.
connect_share.notification.friend_remove: %s is no longer in your friends list.
connect_share.notification.friend_playin: %s is on %s. Open Friends to request to join.
connect_share.identity.title: Connect endpoint identity
connect_share.identity.reset_confirm.mes: The old join address and token will stop being used. This cannot be undone.
connect_share.compatibility.title: Different game setup
